finalText:
**Handoff written to [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).**

Root cause is `dep-4471`, a gateway config change to `connection-per-request`. It starves the size-20 pool, so requests queue and time out as 503.

Impact ran `02:14:18Z` to at least `03:59:27Z`. 530 errors, 83.3% of requests since onset, still failing. Checkout and cart both hit.

Roll back `dep-4471` only. Leave `dep-4472` and `dep-4473` alone.

One catch worth your attention. `/health` stayed 200 throughout, so the load balancer never ejected the node.
